No implementation or specific expression was supplied; provide general guidance without claiming a code audit or verified validation results.","securityFocus":"security-hardening","securityRequirements":["Use a strict allowlisted mathematical grammar or AST interpreter; never pass untrusted expressions to eval or exec","Reject attribute access, imports, arbitrary function calls, indexing, and unsupported syntax; allow only explicitly approved operators, numeric types, names, and functions","Validate before evaluation and fail closed; syntax validity alone does not establish safety","Bound expression length, nesting, AST node count, numeric magnitude, exponents, execution time, and memory to prevent resource exhaustion","Handle division by zero, domain errors, overflow, and nonfinite results explicitly","Keep variable contexts isolated between users and requests","Provide Python integration examples and security tests, including injection attempts and computational abuse","Explain how to use the math validate_syntax or evaluate(validate_only=true) tools before evaluation, while distinguishing grammar checks from runtime safeguards"],"complianceStandards":["OWASP-Top-10"],"language":"python","riskTolerance":"low","analysisScope":["input-validation","error-handling","logging-monitoring","dependency-security","configuration-security","api-security"],"includeCodeExamples":true,"includeMitigations":true,"includeTestCases":true,"prioritizeFindings":true,"outputFormat":"detailed","includeReferences":true}
